Sizing & Box Model Specimen

Fixed box: width 240 px, height 60 px. Content is clipped by height when it overflows (no overflow handling yet).
Percentage box: width 60 % of the content width, height auto. The text below wraps at the computed width.
Min-constraint box: min-width 200 px and min-height 40 px. With short content the box is pushed to the minimums.
Max-constraint box: max-width 320 px. The paragraph inside is short enough to leave the width at auto, below the cap; a longer paragraph would wrap at 320 px.
Border box: explicit width 180 px (content-box semantics - padding and border add on top), 3 px border, 12/16 px padding. Margins separate it from the following grid.
RuleValue
1 px0.75 pt at 96 dpi
Box modelwidth/height explicit = content-box; auto width = border-box-ish
Marginscollapse between siblings (larger wins)
